deadlines.notes: Manchester states this is the closing date for receipt of applications to be given equal consideration. UCAS also gives school or college deadlines that are likely to be earlier.

english_policy.waiver_notes: The page says all applicants from the UK and overseas must show English language proficiency; GCSE/IGCSE English Language grade C/4 (or IGCSE English as a Second Language at the grade stated on the course page) counts. Using the lowest band (Economics); Computer Science and Mechanical Engineering need IELTS 6.5 with no subskill below 6.5. Tests are valid for two years.

english.notes: Economics band; Computer Science and Mechanical Engineering need no subskill below 6.5. In-person IELTS at official test centres only.
Old 0-120 scale. Economics band (20 in each subset); Computer Science and Mechanical Engineering need 22 in each subskill.
New 1-6 scale, as printed on the Computer Science and Mechanical Engineering pages; the Economics page gives no 1-6 figure.
